name: sample_benchmark
description: Original sample corpus about the fictional company Halcyon Robotics (handbook, memo, product spec, supplier contract, field trial report, service plans). Mixes keyword/identifier questions (favour BM25), paraphrased questions (favour dense retrieval), a cross-document contradiction, a summarisation item and an unanswerable question.

items.question: How many days of paid vacation do full-time employees get each year?
items.expected_answer: Full-time employees receive 28 days of paid vacation per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.
items.expected_context: Full-time employees receive 28 days of paid vacation per calendar year, in addition to public holidays.

items.question: When do vacation days that were carried over expire?
items.expected_answer: Up to five unused vacation days can be carried over, and they expire on 31 March.
items.expected_context: Up to five unused vacation days may be carried over into the first quarter of the following year; carried-over days expire on 31 March.

items.question: What is the daily limit for meal reimbursement when travelling for work?
items.expected_answer: Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to 55 euros per day.
items.expected_context: Meals during business travel are reimbursed up to 55 euros per day.

items.question: How quickly must a stolen laptop be reported, and to whom?
items.expected_answer: A lost or stolen device must be reported to the security team at security@halcyon.example within four hours.
items.expected_context: A lost or stolen device must be reported to the security team at security@halcyon.example within four hours.

items.question: How much money does each employee get per year for training and conferences?
items.expected_answer: Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1,800 euros, which does not carry over.
items.expected_context: Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1,800 euros for courses, conferences and books.

items.question: How many days per week can engineers work remotely?
items.expected_answer: The handbook allows up to three remote days per week, but the September 2025 memo reduces this to two days per week for engineering and manufacturing roles from 1 October 2025.
items.expected_context: the maximum number of remote workdays is reduced from three to two days per week for all employees in engineering and manufacturing roles

items.question: Why was the remote work allowance reduced?
items.expected_answer: Because the new Linz prototyping lab requires more in-person collaboration by hardware teams on the Kestrel robotic arm program.
items.expected_context: The change follows the opening of the new Linz prototyping lab, where hardware teams need more in-person collaboration on the Kestrel robotic arm program.

items.question: What is the payload and reach of the Kestrel K2?
items.expected_answer: The Kestrel K2 has a payload of 7.5 kg and a reach of 920 mm.

items.question: How fast does the arm stop after hitting something unexpectedly?
items.expected_answer: Collision detection stops the arm within 12 milliseconds of an unexpected contact.
items.expected_context: Collision detection stops the arm within 12 milliseconds of an unexpected contact.

items.question: Which industrial communication protocols does the KC-3 controller support?
items.expected_answer: The KC-3 controller supports EtherCAT and Modbus TCP.
items.expected_context: The KC-3 controller supports EtherCAT and Modbus TCP and ships with the Halcyon Motion SDK for Python and C++.

items.question: How often is preventive maintenance recommended for the K2?
items.expected_answer: Every 4,000 operating hours, mainly for gearbox lubrication on joints 2 and 3.
items.expected_context: Preventive maintenance is recommended every 4,000 operating hours, mainly for gearbox lubrication on joints 2 and 3.

items.question: What are the payment terms in MSA-2025-117?
items.expected_answer: Invoices must be paid within 45 days of the invoice date; late payments accrue 2 percent interest per month.
items.expected_context: The Buyer shall pay each invoice within 45 days of the invoice date. Late payments accrue interest at 2 percent per month.

items.question: What does a HD-58 gearbox cost at high annual volumes?
items.expected_answer: 289 euros per unit for annual volumes above 5,000 units (312 euros up to 5,000 units).
items.expected_context: The unit price for HD-58 gearboxes is 312 euros for annual volumes up to 5,000 units and 289 euros for volumes above 5,000 units.

items.question: How much notice is needed to end the supplier contract without cause?
items.expected_answer: Either party may terminate for convenience with 90 days' written notice.
items.expected_context: Either party may terminate for convenience with 90 days' written notice.

items.question: What compensation does Halcyon get if gearbox deliveries arrive late?
items.expected_answer: If a delivery is more than 10 business days late, Halcyon gets a credit of 1.5 percent of the order value per late week, capped at 15 percent.
items.expected_context: If a delivery is more than 10 business days late, the Buyer is entitled to a credit of 1.5 percent of the order value per late week, capped at 15 percent.

items.question: Which site saw the biggest productivity improvement in the field trial?
items.expected_answer: The electronics test laboratory in Brno, with a 31 percent throughput gain.
items.expected_context: The electronics laboratory reported the highest throughput gain at 31 percent compared with manual handling.

items.question: What problem occurred at the food packaging site and what was recommended?
items.expected_answer: Two units suffered condensation because IP54 is insufficient for wash-down environments; an IP67-rated variant is recommended for food processing.
items.expected_context: The Ljubljana site experienced condensation in two units because the IP54 rating is not sufficient for wash-down environments.

items.question: Which service plan offers a 4 hour response time and what does it cost?
items.expected_answer: The Enterprise plan offers a 4-hour response time for 11,800 euros per year.

items.question: Summarize the Kestrel K2 field trial results.
items.expected_answer: Over eleven weeks, 14 Kestrel K2 units at three sites (Graz, Brno, Ljubljana) achieved 98.6 percent average uptime and a mean time between failures of 2,150 hours. Brno saw the largest throughput gain (31 percent). Condensation affected two units in Ljubljana, so an IP67 variant is recommended for food processing, and general availability is recommended for electronics and medical assembly in Q1 2026.
items.expected_context: Across all sites the arms achieved an average uptime of 98.6 percent.
items.source_text: The field trial ran for eleven weeks at three customer sites: a medical device assembler in Graz, an electronics test laboratory in Brno and a food packaging line in Ljubljana. In total, 14 Kestrel K2 units were deployed. Across all sites the arms achieved an average uptime of 98.6 percent. The electronics laboratory reported the highest throughput gain at 31 percent compared with manual handling. Mean time between failures was 2,150 hours. The Ljubljana site experienced condensation in two units because the IP54 rating is not sufficient for wash-down environments. The team recommends an IP67-rated variant for food processing customers. The team recommends general availability of the Kestrel K2 for electronics and medical assembly in Q1 2026.

items.expected_answer: I couldn't find sufficient supporting information in your uploaded documents to answer this accurately.
